key_idea: Count the inky squares one row at a time.
steps: The paper has 5 squares in each row and 4 rows. The left column has no ink at all.
Top row: 4 squares have ink. Second row: 4 squares.
Third row: 3 squares. Bottom row: 2 squares.

choice_feedback.A: Count again row by row: 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 is more than 11.
choice_feedback.B: Count again row by row: 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 is more than 12.
choice_feedback.D: Count again row by row: 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 is less than 14.
choice_feedback.E: Count again row by row: 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 is less than 15.
